output.reason: [ev-463f236bf567] says only that "RSA certificates with keys of length 3072 or 4096" will now use SHA-384 or SHA-512. It does not name the configuration field that sets the key length, so the path spec.privateKey.size and the Certificate-only scope are not supported by the evidence. It also does not say whether the hash follows the certificate's own key or the issuing key. The proposed condition also adds an undecidable check on whether consumers support these hashes. That makes the condition narrower than the stated behaviour change, which happens to every such certificate when it rotates. To settle this we need the cert-manager change or code that shows which key and field decide the hash, and every way a certificate's key size can be set.
